title: pvExtractAttributes
body:
## pvExtractAttributes

Converts one attribute association of the input (points, cells, field data, vertices, edges or rows) into a table (vtkTable): one column per array, one row per point or cell (or other element). Composite input gives a multiblock of tables. Use it to inspect or export raw array values, e.g. as CSV through a table writer. Geometry and connectivity are dropped unless AddMetaData adds coordinates.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView's default association is Points; set FieldAssociation to Cells for cell-centred solver fields.
- Point coordinates are not included by default; enable AddMetaData when you need them.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractAttributes`. Identity: `filters/AttributeDataToTableFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AddMetaData` | It is possible for this filter to add additional meta-data to the field data such as point coordinates (when point attributes are selected and input is pointset) or structured coordinates etc. To enable this addition of extra information, turn this flag on. Off by default. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FieldAssociation` | Select the attribute data to pass. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Points","Cells","Field Data","Vertices","Edges","Rows"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Points"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvExtractAttributes",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
